# Pharma Focus Asia

> > Pharma Focus Asia is a quarterly publication from Ochre Media covering pharmaceutical research, clinical trials, manufacturing, and business strategy across the Asia-Pacific region.

The platform features insights from industry experts and organizations on topics ranging from drug discovery and antibody-drug conjugates to clinical trial management and business intelligence. Content focuses on innovations and strategic developments in pharmaceutical markets across Singapore, China, India, Australia, and broader APAC territories.

## Key Topics

- Pharmaceutical Industry
- Clinical Trials
- Drug Discovery & Development
- Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs)
- Business Intelligence
- R&D Management
- Asia-Pacific Markets
- Clinical Research Organisations
- Oncology & Targeted Therapy
- Manufacturing & Supply Chain
- Drug Repurposing
- Regulatory Compliance
- Data Integration & Analytics
- Wearables & Real-World Evidence
